purpose: Two original conceptual illustrations for the Avadhuta's twenty-four teachers guide

assets.brief: Unnamed wandering ascetic from behind in a river and mountain landscape at dawn; editorial miniature-influenced illustration. Nature is the subject; no named divine portrait or historical site.
Ordinary arrow maker focused on an arrow at an outdoor bench while a small procession passes in the distance; imagined narrative interpretation of Bhagavata 11.9.11–13.
